sleeping_bag.name: Hyperion 20F / -6C
sleeping_bag.subtitle: current/archived Hyperion 20F normalized to regular
sleeping_bag.key_features: Regular row; 580 g total; 360 g of 900 fill goose down; EN/ISO tested 0C comfort / -6C limit / -23C extreme; very narrow ultralight design; SynergyLink mattress connectors.
sleeping_bag.marketing_summary: Therm-a-Rest positions the Hyperion as a high-end ultralight sleeping bag aimed at extracting maximum warmth-per-gram for users comfortable with a trim cut and pad-integrated sleep system.
sleeping_bag.manufacturer_claims: Strategic fill placement, premium hydrophobic down, SynergyLink connectors and highly compressible pack size.
sleeping_bag.use_cases: Fast-and-light backpacking, alpine trekking and minimal pack-volume trips where a pad-anchored bag is desirable.
sleeping_bag.source_notes: Verified 2026-05-17. Official US page is still live but marked 'This product is no longer available.' EU pages still surfaced the model. Numeric official USD price is kept out of price_usd because the current captured official price is US$549.95 and the integer price_usd column cannot store cents without loss. Verified French retailer price from Oliunid FR.
sleeping_bag.current_status: archived or unavailable on current US official page; still surfaced on EU channels and French retail
sleeping_bag.comparison_notes: User table weight 567 g appears to reflect a lighter spec than the current regular row. Official current regular weight captured here is 580 g.
